note: Re-judged 2026-11-20 by an independent agent after 51799ad534 changed applyConfig, installUnmatched and installXFRMInterfaceEntries; no tagged unit changed. RFC 4301 Section 4.4.1: "Every SPD SHOULD have a nominal, final entry that matches anything that is otherwise unmatched, and discards it." Tested: "a nominal, final entry that matches anything that is otherwise unmatched, and discards it". Gap: "Every SPD". Producer: internal/component/ike/dataplane/vpp_policy.go::vppPolicyInterface. Producer change read: under owner ruling 5c a catch-all the dataplane refuses at the daemon's start no longer refuses the IPsec block (assertUnmatched, installUnmatchedAtStart; recordInterfaceCatchAllAtStart for an interface SPD): the start keeps every entry the dataplane accepted, logs at Error under doctor-ipsec-spd-catch-all-missing and reports it through ipsec-spd-install, while a reload still refuses. The successful install the tagged units observe is unchanged: the catch-all still goes first on the first apply and is replayed beneath every Ze write, an unmatched clear packet is discarded in the kernel at if_id 0 and on a bound XFRM interface, and a refused interface catch-all fails the reload. The annotation still holds: the final entry exists only in the XFRM SPDs the engine owns, none on VPP SPDs or beneath the OSPF protocol 89 entries. A start-time install refusal is a further window without the final entry, reported rather than prevented, which RFC4301-5.2-1 and 5.2-9 must name. Scoped evidence only; zero whole-requirement credit.
